verses.text: So when we could not bear it any longer, we decided it was good to be left alone in Athens.
We sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the Good News of Christ, to make you strong and to encourage you in your faith,
so that no one would be shaken by these troubles. You know yourselves that we are meant to face such things.
In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we were going to suffer troubles. And it happened that way, as you know.
That is why, when I could not bear it any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I was afraid that the tempter had tempted you in some way, and that all our hard work had been wasted.

But Timothy has just come back to us from you. He has brought good news about your faith and love. He says you always have good memories of us, and that you long to see us, just as we long to see you.
So, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and trouble, your faith has comforted us about you.
Now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.
How can we thank God enough for you, for all the joy we have in front of our God because of you?
Night and day we pray very hard that we may see you again face to face, and give you what is still missing in your faith.
Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, make a way for us to come to you.
May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone grow and overflow, just as our love for you does.
May he make your hearts strong, holy and without blame in front of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.
